title: Internal consulting: diagnose before proposing a solution

videos.script: Henrique writes to Lívia. Our releases keep breaking route planning. We think we need a message broker. Can you help us pick one? {{title}} Lívia does not manage his team. She cannot order anybody to do anything. Everything she achieves, she achieves by being useful enough to be listened to. {{stance}} So before she investigates, she agrees what the help is for. The question, who decides, what she will deliver, and what she will not do. {{contract}} Then she counts. Seven incidents in twenty-three releases. Five of them had the same shape, and none of them was the problem a broker solves. {{causes}} The last part is the hardest. Handing a diagnosis to the people who own the problem, so that they decide, and the idea they started with still has a place.
